notes.title: Day of the Dead Update!
notes.notes:
Content update at last!
There's a new game mode available, which unlocks a new area to explore. A new puzzle leads to an alternate ending and achievement!
Of course, there's a trick to enable that new game mode.
All I can say is that you'll need to give some parts to get a new one.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v1.1.0 brings interface as well as achievements localization
notes.notes:
Hey, 

It took a while, but localization is here! 

Ok, don't expect it to be perfect. I had to rely on AI since I'm working on a 0$ budget. 

If you choose to -and thank you so much if you do, you can help me to improve the text by submitting better lines in the community discussion section.

Talking about discussions, don't hesitate to share what you'd like to see in the game. I intend to add some content over the next coming months.

Lastly, please review the game if you haven't done so. No need for it to be clever or funny, it just helps with the game being recommended on Steam. Thank you!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
New game mode: INFINITE
A responsible citizen and esteemed reviewer of the game commented that he wished for a 1000-lives game mode. I liked the idea, but since I'm a contrarian I couldn't do exactly that. So I've made an Infinite Mode. There might be side effects though. You'll find the option when launching a new game. 

Bug Fixes

Fixed a few invisible triggers that would block the nurse's vision
Fixed the collision between the sink and boxes
Fixed the pause menu that was displayed behind the end credits

Thank you for the reviews
Huge thanks to those who reviewed the game!
If you haven't done so, please write a few words, it helps!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 notes 3/31/2023
notes.notes:
Improved lighting and reflections
Inverted a door for better navigation
Fixed alignment of the door leading to the basement


Don't hesitate to report any issues and share your suggestions! 

Also, if you could please review the game. It helps the discoverability of the game a lot!
Thank you so much for your support!
